full_prompt_en: A square color photograph shows a pale mint sedan parked in front of a low roadside diner on a quiet, sunlit street. The car sits across the lower middle of the frame, its side profile clear against the simple white facade. The diner has a thin striped roofline, a small entrance, windows, a gas pump or vending unit, and a tall sign rising at the right edge. Large leafy trees stand behind and to the left, while a broad muted turquoise sky fills the upper half. The road in front is nearly empty, leaving considerable horizontal space around the car. Midday light is flat but warm, creating soft dark shadows beneath the vehicle and a dusty pale cast on the building. Faded reds in the sign and trim punctuate the pale green, cream, tan, and cyan palette. The framing is straightforward and slightly distant, as if the photographer simply stopped across the road to record an ordinary place. Fine color-film grain, softened contrast, and sun-weathered paint make the scene feel from a past decade without heavy stylization. The whole image finds quiet visual pleasure in mundane geometry, space, and the restrained relationship between vehicle, building, and sky.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形彩色照片呈现一辆浅薄荷色轿车停在安静阳光街道旁低矮的路边餐馆前。车横在画面下方中央，侧面轮廓清楚，背后是简单白色立面。餐馆有细条纹屋檐、小入口、窗户、油泵或售货装置，右缘升起一块高招牌。大叶树立在建筑后方和左侧，上半幅是宽阔的低饱和青蓝天空。车前道路几乎空无一物，车辆周围留有充裕的水平空间。正午光线平而温暖，在车底形成柔和深影，建筑表面带着灰粉似的浅色调。招牌和檐口中褪色的红点缀浅绿、乳白、棕黄和青蓝色谱。取景直接而略远，像摄影者只是站在街对面记录一个普通地方。细微彩色胶片颗粒、柔化反差和被阳光风化的油漆让场景属于过去某个年代，却没有过度风格化。整幅画从寻常几何、空间以及车辆、建筑和天空之间的克制关系中发现安静的视觉趣味。
style_prompt_en: A matter-of-fact color-photography style observes ordinary roadside geometry from a slightly distant, level viewpoint. Pale mint, cream, faded red, tan, and muted cyan form a sun-weathered palette. Flat warm daylight creates modest shadows and soft contrast without theatrical effects. A broad empty foreground or sky gives small everyday objects room to breathe. Fine color-film grain, aged paint, simple signage, and unpolished surfaces preserve a historical documentary feel. Composition relies on clear horizontal bands and an offhand balance of object, building, tree, and open space. The mood is quiet, precise, and gently nostalgic without sentimentality.
style_prompt_zh: 平实的彩色摄影风格从略远而水平的视点观察普通路边几何。浅薄荷绿、乳白、褪色红、棕黄和低饱和青蓝组成被太阳风化的色谱。平而温暖的日光形成适度阴影和柔和反差，没有戏剧特效。宽阔空前景或天空让细小日常物件得以呼吸。细微彩色胶片颗粒、旧漆、简单招牌和未抛光表面保留历史纪实感。构图依靠清楚的水平色带，以及物体、建筑、树和开放空间之间自然不刻意的平衡。情绪安静、准确、轻微怀旧而不煽情。
theme_en: A mint sedan outside a modest roadside diner under a pale sky
theme_zh: 浅薄荷色轿车停在朴素路边餐馆外，天空浅淡
name: Stephen Shore
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
